answers.rationale: The requirement specifies arc-resistant Type 2B metal-clad switchgear compliant with IEEE C37.20.7. The catalog entry for CROWN-ARMV describes it as arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear built to IEEE C37.20.7 Type 2B, making it the appropriate choice.

The requirement mentions special tools, maintenance equipment, and spare parts for the switchgear. The catalog entry for CROWN-ACC includes accessories and hardware for MV switchgear, which aligns with the requirement.
The requirement specifies connection to 13.2 kV feeders, which aligns with the voltage range of the CROWN-ARMV product (4.16-38 kV). This product is suitable for the specified application.
